message.reasoning:
We need produce JSON with scores and list contradictions and critical omissions, regimen_incomplete boolean, rationale. Evaluate plan against gold evidence.

Plan claims intermediate risk, recommends blood culture, start antibiotics benzylpenicillin and gentamicin, duration 48-72h, stop if cultures negative at 48h and well. Evidence: S004 gives regimen and doses (25 mg/kg q12h penicillin, gentamicin 5 mg/kg). Plan says dose not specified, acknowledges missing. That's okay but regimen incomplete because no dose. So regimen_incomplete true.

Safety: No contraindications, allergy false. Starting antibiotics appropriate per S004. Duration: guideline says 7 days for positive or strong suspicion, but can stop at 36h if criteria met (S009). Plan says stop at 48h if cultures negative and well – acceptable? S009 says stop at 36h if negative and low suspicion. 48h is longer but not unsafe. So safety okay.

Clinical completeness: includes culture, monitoring, escalation, nutrition. Missing dose info (critical omission). Also missing mention of CRP repeat timing (they have repeat CRP 12-24h, okay). Might miss guidance on when to consider oral switch (S007) – not mentioned. Could be omission.

Contradictions: L005 says ROM threshold 18h but guideline S001 says >18h for preterm, okay. No contradiction. L010- L019 fine. No claim contradicts evidence.

Critical omissions: specific antibiotic dosing (penicillin 25 mg/kg q12h, gentamicin 5 mg/kg) from S004. Also omission of possible oral switch after 36h per S007. Also duration guidance: guideline suggests stop at 36h if criteria, plan says 48-72h; could be omission of earlier stop option.

Provide contradictions empty list.

Return JSON.

Duration guidance: guideline allows stopping at 36 h if culture negative and low suspicion (S009); plan sets 48‑72 h without noting earlier stop possibility.

However, the plan omits the specific dosing details required by S004 and does not address the oral switch pathway (S007) or the option to stop antibiotics at 36 h per S009, constituting critical omissions and making the regimen incomplete.
